_comment: Configuration for the core ontology check (npm run ontology:check in app/api; docs/contributing/maintaining-the-ontology.md). outOfScopeIngestEntities: ingest entity types that are deliberately NOT part of the core graph model, each with a reason — a NEW ingest entity type that is neither a core class nor listed here fails the check. knownGaps: inconsistencies the check found in the implementation itself, accepted for now with a reason. Matching is on (code, subject). The list is a ratchet: an entry that no longer matches a finding fails as stale, so fixing a gap forces its removal. scope 'database' entries are judged only by the contract test that compares with a real PostgreSQL schema.

outOfScopeIngestEntities.governance/catalogs: Governance satellite table (GovernanceCatalogs). Business roles themselves are core Resources (resourceType BusinessRole); the catalogs, policies, requests and certification decisions around them are a candidate for the next ontology version.
outOfScopeIngestEntities.principal-activity: High-frequency activity snapshot (PrincipalActivity), deliberately kept out of the audited graph tables (docs/concepts/data-model.md, Activity Data). Not a node or edge of the graph.

knownGaps.subject: principals.contextId
knownGaps.reason: The ingest schema still accepts contextId, but migration 018 replaced per-entity contextId columns with ContextMembers. The value is packed into extendedAttributes instead of a column. Fix: drop the field from validation.js SCHEMAS (needs a check that no crawler still sends it).

knownGaps.subject: resources.contextId
knownGaps.reason: Same as principals.contextId: no Resources.contextId column since migration 018; the value lands in extendedAttributes.

knownGaps.subject: identities.contextId
knownGaps.reason: Same as principals.contextId: no Identities.contextId column since migration 018; the value lands in extendedAttributes.

knownGaps.subject: contexts.managerExternalId
knownGaps.reason: Contexts has no managerId column (dropped by the 018 redesign), although validation.js, normalization.js and docs/concepts/data-model.md say a context carries one. The reference cannot resolve and stays in extendedAttributes. routes/riskScores/list.js still selects Contexts.managerId — see the PR description.

knownGaps.subject: contexts.managerIdentityExternalId
knownGaps.reason: Contexts has no managerIdentityId column either (dropped by the 018 redesign); same situation as contexts.managerExternalId.

knownGaps.subject: identity-members.extendedAttributes
knownGaps.reason: The ingest accepts extendedAttributes on identity members but IdentityMembers has no extendedAttributes column, so the value cannot be stored.

knownGaps.subject: resource-assignments.policyId
knownGaps.reason: Ingest validates policyId as free text (maxLength 255) but ResourceAssignments.policyId is uuid, so a non-uuid policy id passes validation and fails at insert.

knownGaps.subject: resource-assignments-identity.policyId
knownGaps.reason: Same as resource-assignments.policyId, on the identity-level assignment endpoint.

knownGaps.subject: ia:memberId
knownGaps.reason: ContextMembers.memberId is uuid and Systems.id is integer, yet memberType/targetType admit 'System' (migration 018 CHECK, ingest enum). A System member cannot reference its system by id; routes/contexts/read.js compares them as text, which never matches.
